data.one_liner: A widget that provides a flip card animation for transitioning between two children.
data.what_it_does: It transitions between two child widgets in a flipping manner. It supports both tap-triggered flipping and gesture-based swipe flipping via controllers.
use_when: You want to show and hide details of a product using a flip animation.
You need a card that flips on tap or swipe gestures.
avoid_when: You need complex 3D scene transformations beyond standard card flipping.
You are looking for general layout frameworks or navigation systems.
strengths: Provides both standard flip cards and gesture-based swipe flip cards.
Includes controllers to trigger flips programmatically.
weaknesses: Limited documentation and features beyond basic card flipping.
Early version (0.0.6) with minimal ecosystem history.
data.setup_notes: Just add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import the package.
data.minimal_example:
FlipCard(
    rotateSide: RotateSide.bottom,
    axis: FlipAxis.horizontal,
    frontWidget: Center(child: Text('Front')),
    backWidget: Center(child: Text('Back')),
)
